schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: javascript-express-multitenant-incomplete-tenant-scope
title: Multi-tenant guard accepts incomplete tenant context or tenant-scoped storage used without scope
  check
summary: 'In multi-tenant mode the request guard used `!hasUrl && !hasKey`, which only rejects when both
  tenant headers are missing. A request with a single header passes with an incomplete tenant context,
  so the resolved tenant scope id can be empty. The workflow-versions handler then built a versioning
  service without checking for that, so backups stored under an empty scope were shared across tenants.
  Both headers must be required, and handlers that touch tenant-scoped storage must fail closed when the
  scope id is empty.

  '

- CWE-285

rule:
  message: 'Incomplete multi-tenant authorization. Either the guard rejects only when ALL tenant identifiers

    are missing (`!a && !b` instead of `!a || !b`), or a handler builds a tenant-scoped versioning

    service without first failing closed when ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT is on and the tenant scope id is empty.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: 'process.env.ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT === ''true'' && !$A && !$B

        '
    - patterns:
      - pattern: 'const $INPUT = $SCHEMA.parse($ARGS);

          '
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern-inside: "try {\n  ...\n  const $V = new $NS.WorkflowVersioningService(...);\n  ...\n\
            }\n"
        - pattern-inside: "try {\n  ...\n  const $V = new WorkflowVersioningService(...);\n  ...\n}\n"
      - pattern-not-inside: "try {\n  ...\n  const $INPUT = $SCHEMA.parse($ARGS);\n  ...\n  if (<... process.env.ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT\
          \ ...>) {\n    ...\n  }\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'In multi-tenant mode require every tenant header (URL and API key) and reject the request
    with a 400 if any one is missing, using `||` between the negated checks. In handlers that read or
    write tenant-scoped storage (such as workflow version backups), resolve the tenant scope id first
    and return an error when multi-tenant mode is on and the scope id is empty.

    '
  example: "if (process.env.ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT === 'true' && (!hasUrl || !hasKey)) {\n  res.status(400).json({\
    \ jsonrpc: '2.0', error: { code: -32602, message: 'Multi-tenant headers required' }, id: null });\n\
    \  return;\n}\n\n// in the handler\nconst input = workflowVersionsSchema.parse(args);\nif (process.env.ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT\
    \ === 'true' && getInstanceScopeId(context) === '') {\n  return { success: false, error: 'Workflow\
    \ version storage is not available for this tenant context' };\n}\n"
